notes: Reconciled from blind labelers A and B, who both gave the same 3 bends: [3,[8,9]], [5,1]/[1,5] and [1,2]. This is a real scan of part 28289002, a stepped channel bracket (open mesh, partial second skin, t~1.48 mm). The profile is: tabbed wall 3/4, a ~37 deg fold into the sloped chamfer band 5/8/9, a ~53 deg fold into the perforated base 1/7, then a 90 deg fold into the shorter wall 2/6 (~99 mm, between relief notches). All three folds are parallel within 0.16 deg. The reconciler checked all prep PNGs, 12 of its own viewpoints, a full along-axis profile, 12 full sections and 33 zoomed corner sections (t=-62..70), plus 6 lengthwise sections. Every station shows the same formed profile. The base, chamfer and both walls are straight lengthwise, with no joggle, kink or end flange. The two tabs on wall 3 lie in the wall's plane. Holes, slots, relief notches and thickness edges are not bends. Thin strips 10 (inner arc of the 53 deg fold) and 11 (outer arc of the same fold) are arc facets, not flanges. Each fold is marked once. [4,5] is the inner duplicate of bend 1. [7,[8,9]] is the outer duplicate of bend 2, which auto-clips to 26 mm because outer skin 7 only covers t<-39.

bends.note: ~37 deg fold (included ~142.7) from tabbed wall 3/4 to the sloped chamfer band 5/8/9, running the full part length (~138 mm). Outer skin: wall outside 3 + chamfer outside 8 and 9, which are coplanar. 8 covers one end and 9 the other; the outer chamfer skin between them is unscanned, so the line is bracketed by data at both ends. The inner pair [4,5] lies 1.47 mm away (one thickness) and was left out.

~53 deg fold (included ~127.4) from chamfer 5/8/9 to perforated base 1/7, running the full part length (~138 mm). Inner skin (chamfer inside 5 + base top 1) is used on purpose. The outer base skin 7 is scanned only over ~26 mm at one end, and the outer arc is unscanned over most of the length, so the outer pair [7,[8,9]] clips to 26 mm. The inner pair is fully observed on both sides and lies 1.46 mm (one thickness) from the outer apex.

90 deg fold from base 1/7 to the short wall 2/6. Outer skin: base top 1 + wall outside 2. The fold spans the wall's length (~99 mm, between the relief notches); the base continues flat past both ends of the wall.
